name: What is the typical step-by-step process of a kitchen upgrade?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical step-by-step process of a kitchen upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard kitchen upgrade follows a logical sequence: demolition, rough trade work, drywall and paint, cabinetry, countertops, backsplash, and final trim. First, old fixtures, counters, or cabinets are carefully removed. Next, trades handle rough plumbing, electrical upgrades, or ducting adjustments. Walls are then repaired and primed. Installers mount base and wall cabinets, followed by templating and installing stone countertops. Once counters sit securely, tile installers set the backsplash. The project concludes with sink hookups, final electrical fixtures, appliance testing, and detail trim work.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes demolition, rough mechanical work, drywall repair, cabinet installation, countertop templating and placement, backsplash tiling, and final fixture hookups.
